Hi Product Hunt! I'm Kai, a musician. I made Clips while promoting my album. Song ads work best when you test several parts of the song, but cutting the same song fifteen ways in a video editor took a whole evening, so I'd make two and guess. Clips does that part. Drop in the song and your footage or photos, and it finds the tempo and every part, then makes a vertical lyric video for each one, cut on the beat with the words synced. Export them all at once, run them for a week, and keep the part that wins. It runs on your Mac, offline, so an unreleased song never leaves it. It's free to try (exports carry a small Clips tag), then $99 once. No subscription. I'd love to hear which part of your song you think would win, and what you'd want Clips to do next.
